A Guy With A Scarf research/Automated match video/zone14

Club pays for a coaching tool

zone14

Vienna, Austria · founded 2020 · active · zone14.ai · last verified 2026-09-19

Club pays for a coaching toolFixed multi-lensNo Italian presence foundEvidence B€500 to €2,000 to start

zone14 rents Austrian built fixed 4K twin camera systems to football clubs on a subscription from EUR 115 to about EUR 130 a month, bundled with its REPLAY analysis software and optional video based player fitness data zone14-01, zone14-02, zone14-03.

For Amateur, semi professional and academy football clubs in German speaking Europe and Croatia that want every home match and training session recorded from a permanent mount and analysed by their own coaches zone14-02, zone14-04. It suits clubs that own or control their ground, since the cameras are mains powered and installed once zone14-02.

zone14 exists because two Viennese founders saw that amateur clubs training four times a week wanted professional style video analysis and that no fixed camera came bundled with the software and the data to do it, so they built the camera, the analysis tool and a video based tracking layer as one subscription zone14-05, zone14-02. It matters now because the Bavarian football association made it official technology partner for more than 4,500 clubs and SK Rapid and Austria Wien's academy use it, which shows a European coaching first alternative to the broadcast and parent led models can reach scale zone14-06, zone14-07. It tells you that in Europe the buyer with the steadiest budget is still the club, and that a vendor that replaces GPS vests with video data has a second reason to be paid.

Price band From EUR 115/month with camera and hardware included (company statement); CORE listed at EUR 130/month, EUR 1,560 billed yearly on the German page after a stated EUR 1,400 sponsorship; ELITE on request; REPLAY software only EUR 20/month zone14-03

Italy zone14 lists Austria, Germany and Croatia as its markets with English, German and Croatian sites, and no Italian club, reseller or pricing was found zone14-07, zone14-01.

Products

  • zone14 TWO (camera). Two 4K tracking cameras with microphones, 180 degree panorama, mains powered fixed installation, uploads over 4G, WiFi or Ethernet zone14-04.
  • zone14 REPLAY (platform). Web analysis software with drawing, tagging boards, playlists, offline clips, user management and third party footage upload zone14-01.
  • zone14 LIVE (add-on). Live tagging, remote and half time analysis, second screen, precision replay and YouTube livestreaming zone14-01.
  • zone14 STATS (add-on). Video based player tracking producing distance, sprints, high intensity runs and running maps without wearables zone14-01, zone14-04.
  • TRAIN and Goal Cam (add-on). Training session recording with multiple balls and an additional goal camera, listed for ELITE zone14-03.

Scale, company-stated

Over 65 clubs in five countries, May 2024 zone14-05; over 200 installed systems across Europe at the BFV partnership announcement zone14-06; markets Austria, Germany and Croatia, June 2026 zone14-07.

2025 and 2026

  • 2026-01-14: zone14 publishes its 2026 football camera comparison covering Veo, Hudl Focus, XbotGo and Pixellot zone14-04.
  • 2026-06-08: Manuel Ortlechner invests in zone14 to support international expansion zone14-07.
  • BFV technology partnership announced with over 200 systems installed in Europe (date not stated in the article) zone14-06.

Not verified

  • The unsubsidised CORE list price and what the EUR 1,400 sponsorship on the German page refers to.
  • ELITE pricing and the 4G data surcharge.
  • Camera frame rate, sensor and low light performance.
  • Hosting location and retention of match video after cancellation.
